design.title: Living constellation — approved A
design.summary: Founder selected A on 22 September 2026. Five coloured domains connect through branching gold light; cycles retain learning.
identity: Near-black ink with ivory serif text
Jade, blue, gold, coral and violet spherical domains
Fine filaments converge and branch around a luminous central memory

relationships.evidence: Centred title above a field of five spheres, without boxed diagram panels.
relationships.css_consequence: Centred live header above full-width WebGL field; controls and details below.

relationships.evidence: Two upper, one right and two lower spheres surround a branching centre.
relationships.css_consequence: Map fixed world coordinates; preserve relative silhouette at wide sizes. Portrait view compacts the horizontal spread.

interactions.purpose: Connect each domain to its signal, action, impact and measure.
interactions.trigger: Select the sphere or its labelled button.
interactions.after: Camera enters the selected colour and shows four facets with relevant business detail.
interactions.primitive: Native buttons over a Three.js canvas.
interactions.timing: Interruptible exponential camera interpolation; no heartbeat scale.
interactions.keyboard: Tab and Enter; Escape returns focus to the selected sphere.
interactions.touch: 44px minimum target; tap surrounding space to return.
interactions.fallback: All business stages and details stay available as HTML.

interactions.purpose: Show a useful cycle contributing retained knowledge and a validated improvement.
interactions.trigger: Play the illustrative sequence or choose Next iteration.
interactions.before: The selected cycle receives connected business signals.
interactions.after: Signals fan through related domains and return evidence; a successful cycle leaves an illuminated memory ring.
interactions.primitive: Canvas plus native playback and iteration buttons.
interactions.timing: A 10 second cycle with concurrent branch activation, paused offscreen.
interactions.touch: Same controls and sphere tap targets.
interactions.reduced_motion: Step through completed static cycles manually.
interactions.fallback: Three named iterations and their business measures are visible in HTML.

open_decisions: Only desktop art supplied; portrait adaptation is inferred without changing the metaphor.
No quantified client results: illustrated successful cycles accumulate capability; actual growth is measured separately.
